name: @pipeworx/mcp-w3c

tools.name: w3c_search
tools.description: Find W3C / web-standards specifications by keyword or topic — HTML, CSS, WCAG accessibility, DOM, SVG, WAI-ARIA, WebAuthn, Fetch, and 800+ others. Answers "what W3C spec defines X", "the CSS grid specification", "web accessibility standard", "which spec covers custom elements". Returns specs with shortname, title, status (Recommendation / Working Draft / Living Standard), organization, and official URL. Example: w3c_search({ query: "flexbox" }).

query.description: Keyword(s) matched against spec titles, e.g. "flexbox", "accessibility", "web components".

tools.name: w3c_spec
tools.description: Detail for one web-standards spec by shortname ("WCAG21", "css-grid-1", "html") or title fragment ("web content accessibility"). Returns title, status, organization (W3C/WHATWG), working groups, series, official URL, editor's-draft URL. Example: w3c_spec({ spec: "WCAG21" }). Accepts shortname/name/title too.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-w3c forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the w3c pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
